tooltip.mobtrinkets.spider_climb: Allows you to climb walls while equipped.
tooltip.mobtrinkets.fire_immunity: Grants immunity to fire and lava damage.
tooltip.mobtrinkets.slow_fall: Slows your fall and negates fall damage.
tooltip.mobtrinkets.short_teleport: Right-click with an empty hand to teleport a short distance.
tooltip.mobtrinkets.arrow_boost: Arrows you fire deal %s%% more damage.
tooltip.mobtrinkets.knockback_boost: Increases the knockback of your melee attacks.
gui.mobtrinkets.title: Mob Trinkets
tooltip.mobtrinkets.sigil: Right-click to unlock a new trinket slot.
tooltip.mobtrinkets.sigil_cost: Costs %s, %s and %s levels for slots 1, 2 and 3.
message.mobtrinkets.not_enough_levels: You need %s experience levels to use this sigil.
message.mobtrinkets.all_unlocked: All trinket slots are already unlocked.
skill.mobtrinkets.honey_shield.desc: Gain a thick layer of absorption hearts.
skill.mobtrinkets.bone_armor.desc: Take much less damage for 12 seconds.
skill.mobtrinkets.ram_charge.desc: Charge forward and smash enemies in your path.
skill.mobtrinkets.horn_blast.desc: A shockwave that hurts and hurls nearby enemies.
skill.mobtrinkets.tidal_surge.desc: Swim like a dolphin and breathe underwater for 20 seconds.
skill.mobtrinkets.riptide_burst.desc: Rocket forward, damaging enemies you pass.
skill.mobtrinkets.slime_bounce.desc: Launch high into the air and fall softly.
skill.mobtrinkets.slime_wave.desc: Toss nearby enemies into the air and slow them.
skill.mobtrinkets.glide.desc: Leap forward and drift down gently.
skill.mobtrinkets.haunt.desc: Curse nearby enemies: glowing, weakness and blindness.

skill.mobtrinkets.venom_strike.desc: Poison and slow the enemy you are looking at.
skill.mobtrinkets.silk_snare.desc: Entangle nearby enemies, almost freezing them in place.
skill.mobtrinkets.magma_shield.desc: Fire resistance and damage resistance for a short time.
skill.mobtrinkets.eruption.desc: Lava bursts under nearby enemies, igniting and launching them.
skill.mobtrinkets.void_pull.desc: Yank the target you are looking at toward you.

gui.mobtrinkets.empty_panel: Place a Mob Trinket in a slot to see its mastery.
